findings.claim: The new doc-drift test maps both the longterm-mem and the procedural-skills lines to the same generic string, "Do not read <source>: ...". If either source's line regressed or disappeared, the other would still satisfy the Contains check. The test does count three '- Do not' lines, so a missing line fails there. The test cannot catch the help or README dropping one of the two sources from the parenthetical source descriptions. It also does not check the reason clauses, such as 'its binary and an MCP entry' or 'the project's lock'.
